items.reason: Five third-party repositories entered real source-level study. Exact-commit ZIP snapshots are required by the all-project v2 source-snapshot policy, but the current connector does not expose source-archive bytes and Book access to the known ncmcm-ci self-hosted runner cannot be verified.
items.resolution: Prefer a trusted Book-accessible self-hosted runner: exact commit archive -> SHA-256/bytes/manifest -> short-lived Actions artifact -> Drive -> read-back -> update manifest/index. If unavailable, use a documented safe alternate path.

items.reason: Drive ID and size are verified, but the available normalized metadata response did not expose a SHA-256 checksum. Foundation A Task 5 consumes canonical GitHub structured assets, so this does not block current validator work.
items.resolution: At a suitable artifact checkpoint, obtain or compute SHA-256 without replacing the Drive object, then update governance/artifact_manifest.json.
